Name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
Synopsis: The remote host is running a version of Apache Log4j that is vulnerable to remote code execution.
Description: A critical vulnerability in Apache Log4j allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server by logging a specially crafted string. This affects versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1.
Solution: Upgrade Apache Log4j to version 2.17.1 or later. Apply vendor patches immediately.

Name: Spring Framework RCE via Data Binding
Synopsis: The remote host is running a vulnerable version of Spring Framework.
Description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Spring Framework versions prior to 5.3.18 and 5.2.20. An attacker with network access can exploit this via HTTP requests.
Solution: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18 or 5.2.20 or later.

Name: Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution (PrintNightmare)
Synopsis: The remote Windows host is vulnerable to a remote code execution vulnerability in the Print Spooler service.
Description: An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to run arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. The Print Spooler service is enabled and accessible over the network.
Solution: Disable the Print Spooler service if not required or apply Microsoft security update KB5004945.

Name: Microsoft Exchange Server SSRF Vulnerability (ProxyLogon)
Synopsis: The remote Microsoft Exchange Server is affected by a server-side request forgery vulnerability.
Description: This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to send arbitrary HTTP requests and authenticate as the Exchange server. It is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.
Solution: Apply the Microsoft Exchange security update released March 2021 (KB5000871).

Name: Remote Desktop Services Weak Encryption
Synopsis: The remote host is running Remote Desktop Services with weak encryption settings.
Description: RDP on this host is configured to use weak or deprecated encryption ciphers which could allow a man-in-the-middle attacker to intercept session data.
Solution: Configure RDP to require Network Level Authentication and enforce strong TLS 1.2 or higher encryption.

Name: Pulse Secure VPN Arbitrary File Read
Synopsis: The remote host is running a version of Pulse Secure VPN that is vulnerable to arbitrary file read.
Description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can send a specially crafted URI to read arbitrary files from the server including session tokens and plaintext credentials.
Solution: Upgrade Pulse Secure to version 9.1R4.2 or 9.0R10 or later.

Name: SSH Weak MAC Algorithms Enabled
Synopsis: The remote SSH server is configured to allow weak MAC algorithms.
Description: The remote SSH server supports one or more weak message authentication code algorithms including MD5 and 96-bit variants. These could be exploited in a man-in-the-middle attack.
Solution: Disable weak MAC algorithms in the SSH server configuration. Restrict to hmac-sha2-256 and hmac-sha2-512.

Name: SSL Certificate Expiring Within 30 Days
Synopsis: The SSL certificate on this host is expiring soon.
Description: The SSL/TLS certificate installed on the remote host is set to expire within 30 days. Expired certificates will cause browser warnings and service disruptions.
Solution: Renew the SSL certificate before the expiration date.

Name: HTTP TRACE Method Enabled
Synopsis: The remote web server supports the TRACE method.
Description: The TRACE HTTP method echoes back the contents of a request and can be exploited in cross-site tracing attacks to steal user credentials.
Solution: Disable the TRACE method in the web server configuration.
